theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α r Z N : ℝ) (A : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ah : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Ψ : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (U : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (V Q : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (K : Set (Rn n)) (c d : ℕ → ℝ), 0 ≤ α → Tendsto c atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto d atTop (𝓝 0) → TendstoUniformlyOn U V atTop K → (∀ z ∈ K, ‖z‖ ≤ r) → (∀ z ∈ K, ‖Q z‖ ≤ Z) → (∀ z ∈ K, ‖V z‖ ≤ N) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ P P' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |ah k z P P' - A P P'| ≤ c k * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ α) * ‖P‖ * ‖P'‖) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Ψ k z P| ≤ d k * ‖z‖ ^ α * ‖P‖) → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k z => ah k z (U k z) (Q z)) (fun z => A (V z) (Q z)) atTop K ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k z => Ψ k z (Q z)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) atTop K
